sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the ship target, IB/IC applicability, exclusive 1985-versus-non-1985 edition branching, canonical kW units, and the inclusive maximum-power-at-least-required-power comparison without imposing an undeclared datatype.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Use the canonical unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloW (the current qudt:KiloW expands to the QUDT schema namespace, not the unit vocabulary). Do not require datatype(?maximumValue) = xsd:decimal or datatype(?requiredValue) = xsd:decimal, because the supplied canonical metadata declares no datatype; compare the numeric values without imposing an undeclared datatype restriction. Preserve the ship target, 1985-edition applicability, IB/IC alternatives, and inclusive maximum-power-at-least-required-power direction.

Repair the applicability alternative to prevent an accidental pass when a ship has both the 1985 edition and another listed edition: the non-1985 branch currently uses sh:in with only sh:minCount 1, so it can pass alongside 1985 and bypass the power check. Encode applicability as an exclusive 1985-versus-not-1985 condition, or otherwise require the edition value to be singular and explicitly exclude the 1985 value from the exemption branch. Do not unnecessarily restrict non-1985 applicability to an incomplete enumerated list unless that list is independently verified as exhaustive. Preserve the prior inclusive maximum-power-at-least-required-power comparison, canonical kW unit, ship target, and IB/IC scope.

Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the ship target, IB/IC applicability, exclusive 1985-versus-non-1985 edition branching, canonical kW units, and the inclusive maximum-power-at-least-required-power comparison without imposing an undeclared datatype.
